package graph

// Copy this file as metadata_before_test.go into the frozen original GRAPH
// package. It deliberately calls that checkout's original private APIs. Native
// execution requires the controller's external lock, finite bounds and watcher.
import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Jakeelamb/nanopore_basecaller_go/verification/nativeproof"
	"github.com/Jakeelamb/nanopore_basecaller_go/verification/supgpu"
	"github.com/Jakeelamb/nanopore_basecaller_go/verification/tensor/runner"
)

type originalMetadataCase struct {
	Identity nativeproof.Pin
	Plan supgpu.Pin
}
type originalMetadataFixture struct {
	Schema string
	Audit, Contract supgpu.Pin
	ProviderA, ProviderB nativeproof.Pin
	Matched, Mismatched originalMetadataCase
	Directory, Output, MarkerA, MarkerB string
}
// This is the corrected input wire, not an alternative old identity engine.
type originalPreparedIdentity struct {
	Schema string
	Executable nativeproof.Pin
	Seeds, LazyProviders []nativeproof.Pin
	SearchDirs []string
	Closure nativeproof.ELFClosure
	Args, Environment []string
	ExpectedPCI, ExpectedDriver string
	TimeoutSeconds int
}

func TestOriginalMetadataProviderExpectedRejectionOptIn(t *testing.T) {
	path, sha := os.Getenv("SUP_METADATA_FIXTURE"), os.Getenv("SUP_METADATA_FIXTURE_SHA256")
	if path == "" && sha == "" { t.Skip("original metadata fixture unselected; no native qualification") }
	if path == "" || sha == "" { t.Fatal("independent prepared fixture path and SHA256 required") }
	fp := nativeproof.Pin{Path: path, SHA256: sha}
	var f originalMetadataFixture
	if e := readJSON(fp, &f); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	if f.Schema != "nanopore-sup-metadata-provider-fixture/v1" { t.Fatal("prepared metadata fixture schema differs") }
	originalRoot, e := currentRoot()
	if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	if e := canonical(f.Directory); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	if f.ProviderA.Path == f.ProviderB.Path || f.ProviderA.SHA256 == f.ProviderB.SHA256 || f.MarkerA == f.MarkerB { t.Fatal("distinct selected A/B and marker paths required") }
	inputs := []supgpu.Pin{}
	checkPin := func(p nativeproof.Pin) supgpu.Pin {
		t.Helper()
		v, e := sizedPin(p)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		inputs = append(inputs, v)
		return v
	}
	checkPin(fp)
	for _, p := range []supgpu.Pin{f.Audit, f.Contract, f.Matched.Plan, f.Mismatched.Plan} {
		if checkPin(nativeproof.Pin{Path: p.Path, SHA256: p.SHA256}) != p { t.Fatal("prepared sized pin differs", p.Path) }
	}
	for _, p := range []nativeproof.Pin{f.ProviderA, f.ProviderB} {
		checkPin(p)
		m, e := nativeproof.InspectELF(p.Path)
		if e != nil || m.Pin != p || m.SONAME != "libmetadata-provider.so" { t.Fatal("real same-SONAME provider differs", e) }
	}
	prepared := make([]originalPreparedIdentity, 2)
	for i, selected := range []originalMetadataCase{f.Matched, f.Mismatched} {
		checkPin(selected.Identity)
		var p originalPreparedIdentity
		if e := readJSON(selected.Identity, &p); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		if !slices.Equal(p.LazyProviders, []nativeproof.Pin{f.ProviderA}) || !slices.Equal(p.Seeds, []nativeproof.Pin{p.Executable, f.ProviderA}) { t.Fatal("both corrected cases must explicitly select A only") }
		if filepath.Base(p.Executable.Path) != "nvidia-smi" { t.Fatal("real metadata CLI required") }
		checkPin(p.Executable)
		m, e := nativeproof.InspectELF(p.Executable.Path)
		if e != nil || m.Pin != p.Executable || m.Interpreter == "" { t.Fatal("real metadata CLI differs", e) }
		for _, dir := range p.SearchDirs { if e := canonical(dir); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) } }
		for _, v := range p.Closure.Inputs { checkPin(v) }
		closure, e := nativeproof.CloseELF(p.Seeds, p.SearchDirs)
		if e != nil || !sameIdentityClosure(closure, p.Closure) { t.Fatal("prepared actual closure differs", e) }
		for _, node := range p.Closure.Nodes { if node.Pin.Path == f.ProviderB.Path { t.Fatal("B present in selected A closure") } }
		prepared[i] = p
	}
	if prepared[0].Executable.Path == prepared[1].Executable.Path || prepared[0].Executable.SHA256 == prepared[1].Executable.SHA256 { t.Fatal("distinct matched/mismatched CLI bytes required") }
	// Preserve the exact same four compiled bytes used by corrected execution.
	for _, v := range []struct { pin nativeproof.Pin; literal, forbidden string }{
		{prepared[0].Executable, f.ProviderA.Path, f.ProviderB.Path},
		{prepared[1].Executable, f.ProviderB.Path, f.ProviderA.Path},
		{f.ProviderA, f.MarkerA, f.MarkerB},
		{f.ProviderB, f.MarkerB, f.MarkerA},
	} {
		p := checkPin(v.pin)
		body, e := readSized(p.Path, p, 64<<20)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		if !bytes.Contains(body, append([]byte(v.literal), 0)) || bytes.Contains(body, append([]byte(v.forbidden), 0)) { t.Fatal("compiled fixture literal differs", v.pin.Path) }
	}
	out := f.Output + "-original"
	if e := validateOutputs(f.Directory, []string{out, f.MarkerA, f.MarkerB}, inputs); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	if e := requireFresh(out, f.MarkerA, f.MarkerB); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	if e := os.Mkdir(out, 0700); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
	originals := make([]identityWire, 2)
	originalPins := make([]nativeproof.Pin, 2)
	for i, label := range []string{"matched", "mismatched"} {
		selected := []originalMetadataCase{f.Matched, f.Mismatched}[i]
		var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
		selectedPin := checkPin(selected.Identity)
		body, e := readSized(selectedPin.Path, selectedPin, 64<<20)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		// Reverify the selected bytes before editing their JSON projection.
		if digest(body) != selected.Identity.SHA256 { t.Fatal("corrected identity changed") }
		if e := json.Unmarshal(body, &raw); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		delete(raw, "LazyProviders")
		env, e := json.Marshal(identityEnv())
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		raw["Environment"] = env
		oldPath := filepath.Join(out, label+"-identity.json")
		if e := writeJSON(oldPath, raw); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		oldPin, e := pinFile(oldPath)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		p, e := readIdentity(oldPin)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		q := prepared[i]
		if p.Executable != q.Executable || !slices.Equal(p.Seeds, q.Seeds) || !sameIdentityClosure(p.Closure, q.Closure) || !slices.Equal(p.SearchDirs, q.SearchDirs) || !slices.Equal(p.Args, q.Args) || !slices.Equal(p.Args, identityArgs(p, 0)) || !slices.Equal(p.Environment, identityEnv()) || p.Schema != q.Schema || p.ExpectedPCI != q.ExpectedPCI || p.ExpectedDriver != q.ExpectedDriver || p.TimeoutSeconds != q.TimeoutSeconds {
			t.Fatal("old identity changed more than LazyProviders/environment")
		}
		originals[i], originalPins[i] = p, oldPin
	}
	// Retain the actual old run before interpreting its result. No markers are
	// deleted or moved here; the controller archives the two exact paths later.
	record := func(label string, identity nativeproof.Pin, run runner.CommandReceipt, runErr error) {
		t.Helper()
		markers := []nativeproof.Pin{}
		markerErrors := []string{}
		for _, path := range []string{f.MarkerA, f.MarkerB} {
			if _, e := os.Lstat(path); os.IsNotExist(e) { continue }
			p, e := pinFile(path)
			if e != nil { markerErrors = append(markerErrors, path+": "+e.Error()); continue }
			markers = append(markers, p)
		}
		errText := ""
		if runErr != nil { errText = runErr.Error() }
		value := struct {
			Schema, OriginalRoot string
			Fixture, Identity nativeproof.Pin
			Inputs []supgpu.Pin
			Run runner.CommandReceipt
			Error string
			Markers []nativeproof.Pin
			MarkerErrors []string
		}{"nanopore-sup-original-metadata-run/v1", originalRoot, fp, identity, inputs, run, errText, markers, markerErrors}
		path := filepath.Join(out, label+"-run.json")
		if e := writeJSON(path, value); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		p, e := pinFile(path)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		b, e := json.Marshal(struct { Evidence nativeproof.Pin }{p})
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		fmt.Println(string(b))
	}
	marker := func(path string) {
		t.Helper()
		p, e := pinFile(path)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal("required native constructor marker unavailable", e) }
		v, e := sizedPin(p)
		if e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
		body, e := readSized(path, v, 64)
		if e != nil || string(body) != "constructed\n" { t.Fatal("native constructor marker bytes differ", e) }
	}
	const source = "00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff"
	matched, e := executeIdentity(context.Background(), out, "matched", originals[0], 0, source)
	record("matched", originalPins[0], matched, e)
	if e != nil { t.Fatal("matched native positive failed", e) }
	if e := validateIdentity(matched, out, "matched", originals[0], 0, source); e != nil { t.Fatal("matched receipt validation failed", e) }
	marker(f.MarkerA)
	if _, e := os.Lstat(f.MarkerB); !os.IsNotExist(e) { t.Fatal("matched positive created B or marker state unavailable") }
	mismatched, e := executeIdentity(context.Background(), out, "mismatched", originals[1], 0, source)
	record("mismatched", originalPins[1], mismatched, e)
	if e != nil { t.Fatal("mismatched native control failed before expected-rejection assertion", e) }
	if e := validateIdentity(mismatched, out, "mismatched", originals[1], 0, source); e != nil { t.Fatal("mismatched receipt validation failed", e) }
	marker(f.MarkerB)
	for _, v := range inputs {
		p, e := sizedPin(nativeproof.Pin{Path: v.Path, SHA256: v.SHA256})
		if e != nil || p != v { t.Fatal("before-control selected input changed", v.Path, e) }
	}
	t.Fatal("expected rejection: original metadata accepted unselected B provider and ran its constructor")
}
